predictions.selection_reason: changed installer URL from HTTPS to HTTP -> direct download of build tools over insecure channel -> potential for MITM or tampering
predictions.source_summary: Hardcoded URL in constants.js configuration object
predictions.sink_summary: nugget download library with strictSSL: false, downloading executable files to user's system
predictions.guard_summary: No HTTPS validation (strictSSL: false), no integrity checks, no signature verification
predictions.risk_pattern: Insecure download of build tools over HTTP instead of HTTPS with SSL validation disabled, allowing potential MITM attacks
predictions.context_summary: URL flows from constants.js -> getBuildToolsInstallerPath() -> downloadTools() -> nugget() with strictSSL disabled
unresolved_facts: Whether Microsoft's download server supports HTTPS for this specific file
Whether executable files are verified after download
Whether there are additional integrity checks in the installation process
